title: Assert check_exit_code, enforcement_matches_mode, and evidence attribution in the harness PASS predicate
attempted: Extracted the per-repo PASS predicate into scripts/external-eval-predicate.mjs (repoVerdict, named assertions, FAIL carries the failing assertion names, printed and recorded as failed_assertions). Added three assertions: (1) check_exit_code === REPOS[].expectedExitCode, read from per-repo data with a fail-closed guard (missing/non-integer expectation is a FAIL, and the runner refuses to start if a suite repo lacks one); (2) enforcement_matches_mode === true strictly (null/absent was a silent pass under the old !== false idiom); (3) attribution: the finding's leading evidence file_path must equal the injected route itself (new recorded fields injected_route + injection_evidence_file), closing the papermark-barrel false-pass shape. Ad-hoc mode gained --expect-exit-code and fails closed without it. Harness test suite grew 7 synthetic predicate tests plus baseline-shape pins (check_exit_code===expected_exit_code, enforcement true, attribution equality per row).
evidence: RED (before): env-gated perturbation of taxonomy's recorded result (check_exit_code 3->0, enforcement_matches_mode true->null) - old predicate printed 'ok taxonomy' status PASS, and '--only taxonomy --update' exited 0 printing 'baseline updated - 1/1 passing' (the exact B-4 false green); 6 new synthetic predicate tests all failed 'expected FAIL, received PASS'. GREEN (after): identical perturbation plus a barrel-attributed evidence file now prints 'FAIL taxonomy / failed: injection_attributed_to_injected_file, check_exit_code_matches_expected, enforcement_matches_mode', suite exit 1; harness tests 13/13. Recorded truthful expected exit codes: taxonomy 3, dub 0, formbricks 2, calcom 3, papermark 3, midday 3, openstatus 2 - the 3s are S1-01 transitional per the TDD pre-registration and flip when S1-04 lands (block repos to 2, warn repos to 0). Verification: pnpm build ok; pnpm test:engine ok (all suites 0 failed); pnpm -r test 460 cli + 57 mcp + rest pass; pnpm test:e2e 65/65; pnpm eval:external 'no change vs baseline - 7/7 passing'. Attribution genuinely holds at HEAD on all 7 repos including papermark (evidence file == injected route).
